Looking for a mod or person willing to adopt this subverse.

First off, I'd like to thank everyone who has subscribed to the sub! This is a great community, and I can't wait to continue its growth. Whether you post, comment, or lurk, I'm grateful for your help in building the sub. That being said, I'd like to address a concern that has been brought to my attention by @SpaceGoose:

As a genre, Glitch Hop is extremely diverse; from upbeat, 'happy' songs (i.e.; much of KOAN Sound) to hard, heavy tracks (I'd say Kosmo), Glitch Hop is filled with a wonderful variety that makes it what we know and love. As a result, it's often difficult to distinguish whether or not a song is part of the Glitch genre, especially considering the fact that its part of EDM. I intend to keep this a sub devoted to Glitch Hop music, and that will require removing irrelevant posts or songs of separate genres. However, since everyone has a different ear and taste in music, I don't want to be the sole decider of what content stays or not. In an effort to improve and maintain the quality of this sub, especially as it grows, I'm implementing the following policy:

  • If a post or song link is blatantly not Glitch Hop, or, for some reason, is a troll post, I (or any future mod) will remove it.

  • If a song posted is hard to classify, I'm leaving it up to you, the community, to decide it's fate. Good, funky vibes are a part of glitch hop; if you feel as though a song is too far away from the genre, PM me about it. If enough members of the community support the post's removal, I'll do so and notify the user why.

If you have any questions or need clarification, don't be afraid to ask! I'm entirely open to comments, suggestions, or criticism; improving the sub for the better of all is my ultimate goal.

~zoi
